title: August Ladies Luncheon
summary: August Ladies Lunch We will go to Coco's Crush Bar and Grill for Ladies Luncheon. Please see the bulletin board in your North or South clubhouse for all your details and address. Please remember to sign up with your $5 to hold your spot. We will return the $5 at the luncheon. The start time is 11:30. Your lead team is Cindy Cothran and Linda Keehl. Please see them to hold your spot.
